# Custom build configuration for the Engine directory module (HEngineBase).
# MakeBuild regenerates this directory's CMakeLists.txt from scratch on every
# generation pass, so anything that must survive belongs here rather than in a
# hand-edit of the generated file.
# Read this first: MakeBuild's ParseList() de-duplicates identical lines and drops
# empty ones, so a repeated separator line is silently thrown away. Every break in
# this file therefore carries its own text - including the two below.
# [why] The CodingStandards target:
# CodingStandards.{h,cpp} is the executable statement of this project's style; every
# other file derives its rules from it. It belonged to no target, so it silently
# drifted out of agreement with the standard it documents - 4-space indentation in a
# tabs-only tree, a brace rule described backwards, and an include layout that its
# own formatter rejects. Compiling it here makes that drift loud instead of quiet:
# it is built with the same -Wall -Werror flags as the engine, in Debug, Dev and
# Release.
# [why] The target is deliberately NOT linked into HEngine:
# This is a documentation artefact, not runtime code, and it must not reach a
# shipping binary; it is therefore neither installed into lib/ the way the sibling
# modules are, nor redirected there via CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY - the .a stays
# inside the build tree.
add_library (CodingStandards STATIC
 CodingStandards.cpp
 CodingStandards.h
${PLATFORM_SOURCES}
)
